The logo: M1 a bit wider, stem to stem, and wider still

Holger, 27 Sep: use M1, but a bit wider, just so that the long parts of the d in Card and the f in of align on their right sides. So World of is sized until the right side of the f’s stem sits on the right side of the d’s stem, and then, at his next word, two steps wider still. M1 is kept as it was. And 1a a bit less wide: the words at 78% of the fan instead of 85%, as row 1a.5 beside 1a. The keepers stay as they are. Every row has a number and a name. Each row: the logo at 64px, then the site’s bar at a desktop width with the logo 32px tall, and a phone with it 24px tall.

N M1 a bit wider, stem to stem, and wider still

Holger: use M1, but a bit wider, just so that the long parts of the d in Card and the f in of align on their right sides; then a bit wider still. So World of is sized until the right side of the f’s stem sits on the right side of the d’s stem (N1), and then two steps past it (N2, N3).
